 Why BTS concert was extra special for BINI Sheena
 MJ Felipe ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 21, 2026 01:23 PM PHT 
 BINI Aiah, Colet, Stacey, Mikha and Sheena at the 'Arirang' concert of Korean supergroup BTS. Photo from BINI_ph MANILA — After wrapping up their Signals World Tour in Taipei, five of the eight members of BINI took the chance and traveled to Kaohsiung to watch the ‘Arirang’ concert of Korean supergroup BTS.
 Aiah, Colet, Stacey, Mikha and Sheena had a blast watching and fangirling over BTS. The BINI members maximized the fan experience, from soundcheck to the main show. 
 “Ang saya po ng experience kasi medyo malapit po kami. And kitang-kita mo sila, ang gwapo po nila. Grabe yung experience, respect sa mga fans talaga. Lalo na sa blooms. Grabe yung journey namin, sobrang init ng pila, ang daming tao, sobrang respect talaga.” said Colet.  
 “And we also paid for it,” added Jhoanna.
 ADVERTISEMENT
 “Ako yung pinakamalakas ang bunganga doon. As in soundcheck pa lang yung sigaw ko ang lala. Hanggang Taipei, rinig!” said Stacey.
 But the concert was extra special for Sheena, who revealed that she has been a fan "for so, so long."
 "Like, 'Wings' era pa lang nila," she said. "naaalala ko lang talaga, siyempre (taga) probinsya ka, tapos natatandaan ko nagpupunta sila ng Manila. Umiiyak ako kay mommy nun na bilhan niya ako ng Gen Ad na ticket.
 "Tapos si mommy, ang hirap nung kasi mag-a-absent ako sa school, siya mag-a-absent sa work, sa Manila, saan kami mag-stay? Sobrang imposible niya at that time," she recalled. "So before tinanggap ko na lang, so gumagawa na lang ako ng D-I-Y na merch na lang ng BTS. 
 "Doon nakapanood kami, hindi lang sa Pinas, sa Taiwan pa. Grabe, sobrang grateful lang namin."
 "And super nainspire kami sa BTS, lalo na ako. Parang food chain siya eh - nainspire kami sa BTS, kami nakakainspire kami ng blooms. So blooms, malay niyo in five to ten years Kpop na rin kayo. Everything is possible talaga!" said Sheena.
 Stacey added: "Nakakainspire sila, sa lahat ng fans. Tulad ng sabi ni Sheena na, parang hindi lang kami nandoon to watch, nandoon din kami kasi gusto namin mainspire, gusto namin matouch yung hearts namin, at mas may pang-hugutan pa kami sa mga performances namin."
